# MemoMark

**MemoMark** is a memorable Markdown knowledge/notes CRUD application.

> **Name meaning:** Memo + Markdown = MemoMark.

## Stack

- Node.js
- Express
- EJS
- Marked
- Highlight.js
- JSON file persistence

## Data model

```json
{
  "id": "autogenerated-uuid",
  "title": "Java HashMap",
  "content": "# HashMap\n\nMarkdown content",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-05T00:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-10-05T00:00:00.000Z"
}
```

## CRUD

| Operation | Method | URL |
|---|---|---|
| List | GET | `/` |
| Create form | GET | `/notes/new` |
| Create | POST | `/notes` |
| Read | GET | `/notes/:id` |
| Edit form | GET | `/notes/:id/edit` |
| Update | POST | `/notes/:id/update` |
| Delete | POST | `/notes/:id/delete` |

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

Open:

```text
http://localhost:3000
```

## Development

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Markdown + code highlighting

Example:

````markdown
# Java Example

```java
public class HelloWorld {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println("Hello World");
    }
}
```
````

The Markdown is rendered by **Marked**, and fenced code blocks are highlighted by **Highlight.js**.

## Important

The application stores all notes in:

```text
data/notes.json
```

IDs are generated using:

```js
crypto.randomUUID()
```


## Theme Toggle

MemoMark includes a Light/Dark theme toggle. The selected theme is stored in browser `localStorage` using the key `memomark-theme`, so it survives page refreshes and future visits.

If no preference exists, MemoMark follows the operating system's preferred color scheme.


## Closed-loop Prev/Next

Note navigation wraps around: Previous from the first note opens the last note, and Next from the last note opens the first.

## Bookmarks

Bookmarks are stored separately in `data/bookmark.json`.

```json
["note-id-1", "note-id-2"]
```

Routes: `POST /notes/:id/bookmark`, `GET /bookmarks`, `GET /api/bookmarks`.
